latest_release.name: Dynamic v3.1 GGUFs + Performance Fixes
latest_release.body:
Qwen3.8-27B is here with Dynamic v3.1 GGUFs, ready to run locally with Unsloth. This release also brings major performance improvements, smoother Glass rendering, revamped code blocks and Thinking UI, HTML/PDF chat exports, and new image generation and coding agent features.

## Highlights
- **New Qwen3.8-27B** Dynamic v3.1 GGUFs.
- **Faster chats:** Major performance improvements to streaming, scrolling, menus and dialogs, especially in long conversations.
- **Smoother Glass:** Reduced lag while typing, scrolling and generating.
- **Revamped code blocks and Thinking:** Independently scrolling, expandable panels with improved syntax highlighting.
- **HTML and PDF exports:** Export chats directly from the chat menu.
- **Image queue:** Queue upcoming image generations while another is rendering.
- **Claude Code and Codex on MLX:** Run coding agents with MLX models through `unsloth start`.

## Chat & UI

- Streaming performance no longer degrades as conversations grow.
- Smoother scrolling with background images, with or without Glass.
- Faster menus, dialogs and browser pane loading.
- Read aloud starts after the first sentence instead of waiting for the entire response.
- Chat preferences, time format and spell check now sync with your account.

## Images & Video

- FLUX.2 and FLUX.3 use **36–43% less VRAM** during image decoding at the same speed.
- Queue image generations from the Images page or API.
- INT8 and FP8 image models now load on older NVIDIA GPUs, including T4.
- Fixed black image outputs with FLUX.3.
- LTX-2.5 FP8 now runs on 24 GB GPUs.
- Cosmos3-Nano can continue video clips from their first or last frames.

## Coding Agents & API

- Run Claude Code and Codex with MLX models on Mac using `unsloth start`.
- New Unsloth MCP preset lets coding agents access Unsloth tools.
- Claude API models without an explicit token limit no longer stop at 1,024 tokens.
- MLX models now return a proper context-length error instead of an empty response.

## Training

- `model.generate()` is now **2–8x faster on T4 GPUs** by default across FastModel models.
- Video columns are now correctly supported when training vision models.
- Ulysses context parallelism now supports Kimi-Linear, DeepSeek, MiniMax and Gemma 4 text models.

## What's Changed
* Bump install.sh / install.ps1 pins to unsloth>=2026.11.3 by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16920
* Studio GGUF: keep the stock Q8_0 forward on torch below 2.7 by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16911
* Studio: merge LoRA and LoKR adapters into ComfyUI-quantized weights by @oobabooga in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16874
* Studio: restore WebKitGTK offscreen code fences in batches and on any pointer release by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16919
* Studio: warm the compile workers and Triton / inductor keys during a load that compiles inline by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16918
* Studio: pre-seed the float specialisations of an image load's first compiled render by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16917
* Studio diffusion: reuse the early quant probe's result instead of spawning a second child by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16910
* Studio: keep Glass fast on WebKit by giving glass surface contents their own layers by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16921
* Studio: release a streamed encoder's safetensors mapping once its weights are pinned by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16914
* Studio: load long chat history faster on Linux by mounting parked history in larger steps by @danielhanchen in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16924
* Studio: decode escaped spreadsheet text during RAG indexing by @DimitriChrysafis in https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16712
* Studio: refuse MLX prompts
